distanceSource: Gaia DR3 parallax 7.5965 +/- 0.0179 mas (same row, RUWE 1.01): 131.64 pc, no zero-point correction
radiusSource: Radius 4.826 (4.729 to 4.924) from Gaia DR3 FLAME (Creevey et al. 2023, A&A 674, A26; astrophysical_parameters of the same source): 3,357,558 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 1.660 (1.610 to 1.700) from Gaia DR3 FLAME (Creevey et al. 2023, A&A 674, A26; astrophysical_parameters of the same source); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 5014 +/- 6.6 K from Andrae et al. (2023), A&A 674, A27 (Gaia DR3 GSP-Phot), astrophysical_parameters of Gaia DR3 4893980371818915456: teff_gspphot 5014.146 K (16th-84th percentiles 5007.2827-5020.536), the temperature FLAME used (https://doi.org/10.1051/0004-6361/202243462). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
effectiveTemperatureSource: Andrae et al. (2023), A&A 674, A27 (Gaia DR3 GSP-Phot), astrophysical_parameters of Gaia DR3 4893980371818915456: teff_gspphot 5014.146 K (16th-84th percentiles 5007.2827-5020.536), the temperature FLAME used (https://doi.org/10.1051/0004-6361/202243462)
surfaceGravitySource: log g from the mass and radius in packages/astronomy/data/bodies/mouhoun.json (sources in its physicalNotes), log10(GM/R^2) in cgs: 3.291, rounded to two decimals
